download.message: Public installer and update packages are available for this release.

items: Fixed SQL-free terminal PCs aborting while trying to start a nonexistent local SQL Server service.
Made each terminal keep its one-time saved office server, database, and encrypted SQL login permanently.
Prevented terminal startup from discarding SQL Authentication credentials or drifting to a local database.

versions.title: Startup recovery and verified SQL client setup

items: Replaced fatal SQL login startup errors with guided database connection recovery and verified retry.
Fixed generated client setup packs to verify credentials before saving and protect SQL passwords with Windows machine-level DPAPI.
Stopped database-dependent startup safely when the authoritative office SQL database is unavailable.
Removed developer-machine SQL targets from packaged defaults and added a guarded terminal SQL login repair utility.

versions.title: LAN Control and managed terminal deployment

items: Redesigned LAN Control dashboard with fleet status, filters, readiness details and live deployment progress.
Added subnet-aware terminal discovery, saved terminals, authenticated preflight checks and WinRM preparation.
Added staged terminal deployment with SHA-256 verification, pilot rollout, retry and cancellation.
Added the ServoERP Terminal Agent Windows service for health, diagnostics, updates and approved LAN commands.
Added a SQL-free terminal installer embedded in the enterprise installer and protected connection credentials with Windows DPAPI.
Replaced the low-information quotation value graph with an actionable follow-up board for overdue contacts, quotations expiring within seven days, and the highest-value open opportunities.
Added one-click quotation opening from every action row, company-aware action filtering, clear empty states, and regression coverage for action prioritisation and dashboard replacement.

LAN Control now attempts to enable the built-in Windows WinRM service automatically on reachable terminals through credentialed WMI/DCOM, waits for WinRM readiness, and continues deployment without a separate manual preparation step when Windows policy permits it.

LAN deployment now defaults to a self-contained current ServoERP application payload generated from the files already embedded in the Enterprise installation, removing the requirement to browse for or download a second installer.
Kept a local administrator bootstrap script and clear per-PC failure reporting for terminals whose firewall, Remote UAC, or domain policy blocks automatic WinRM preparation.
Expanded LAN Control Center with private-network PC discovery, WinRM readiness, enrolled-terminal status, and selectable remote deployment.

Added credential-on-demand Enterprise installer orchestration that configures the shared office SQL connection, installs ServoERP per machine, creates the public desktop shortcut, and records per-PC results without storing deployment credentials.
Added a one-time WinRM bootstrap script for unmanaged workgroup terminals and scoped TrustedHosts setup to selected PCs only.
Added the private Office API pilot client integration for guarded payments, inventory movements, and purchase receiving.
Added authorized-company discovery, active-company visibility, Office Server status, HTTPS deployment scripts, and retry-safe operation identifiers.
Prepared a clean Release package for multi-PC office-server visibility validation, with aligned installer and update metadata.
Added LAN Control Center for office-server administrators: enrolled ServoERP PCs now send a one-minute SQL-backed heartbeat with app version, SQL target, and health status.
Added safe server-to-client commands to request a health check or verified background update check. Clients never accept remote execution, credentials, or forced software installation.

Consolidated end-user reliability fixes: supplier list totals, prospect lifecycle conversion, valid TAN entry, quotation duration and print layout, HSN/SAC reuse, invoice inventory selection, and purchase-order GST/document details.
Hardened shared-office data behavior: live SQL-backed updates remain authoritative, with unsafe offline business-data replay disabled until conflict-safe multi-device support is approved.
Added and passed focused supplier-search, PDF-template, guardrail, UI-policy, and offline-sync regression coverage for this release candidate.

versions.title: Interactive User Guide and Multi-PC Setup

items: Added User Guide to the sidebar with an interactive per-PC setup checklist for office server preparation, terminal-PC SQL connection, shared storage, verification, client setup packages, and daily safety checks.
Connected the guide directly to the in-app server setup, connection setup, shared storage, database check, and client-package actions.
Reissued the public client release after completed executable and SQL end-to-end guardrail verification.

Added an executable end-to-end guardrail regression test that creates isolated QA records, verifies duplicate payment reference, overpayment, negative-stock, and duplicate PO-receipt blocks through the real application services, then proves cleanup completed.
Added service-level transaction guardrails: duplicate UTR/reference blocking, overpayment blocking, duplicate PO-receipt protection, and negative-stock prevention.

Added Manager/Admin-only audited guardrail override policy, additive guardrail health/audit tables, and SQL uniqueness rails for invoice numbers, PO numbers, and payment references when existing data is clean.
Added safe multi-PC guardrail schema foundations for edit presence and idempotent operations; all financial and stock protections remain enforced against the shared SQL Server.

Added a silent post-update backend maintenance runner. After a Velopack-installed update first opens, it applies safe schema guards and client-PC registration once per version; if the office SQL Server is unavailable, it logs the result and retries on the next launch.
Quotation printouts now derive the displayed validity from the selected calendar dates and no longer repeat statutory registration details already present on the letterhead.
Purchase orders now print supplier phone/email, configured supplier bank details, required-delivery date, payment terms, and the configured authorised signatory.
Hardened the rendered PDF regression gate so every check waits for and verifies a freshly generated report.

versions.title: Multi-PC client setup and regression safeguards

items: Added clear Multi-PC Setup for client PCs connecting directly to the shared office SQL Server, with per-PC node registration for traceability.
Changed shared-SQL change records from misleading permanent Pending status to Recorded, including safe normalization of legacy audit rows.
Added rendered PDF/template regression checks and a guarded offline-sync policy test; offline business-data replay remains disabled until conflict-safe multi-device behavior is approved.

versions.title: Supplier list and quotation calendar reliability

items: Supplier Management now clears both list caches when opened, so active suppliers appear immediately and opening the page never changes supplier status.
Quotation validity is selected with a calendar date and continues to calculate the exact customer-facing duration in days or whole weeks.
Removed the input-selection event burst that caused blue focus and selection flicker during page navigation.
Purchase orders now automatically apply CGST and SGST for intra-state suppliers and IGST for inter-state suppliers.
Published the silent background-update workflow: verified Velopack packages now download without interrupting work and install safely when ServoERP closes.
Included recent editable-field and invoice entry refinements for a cleaner day-to-day desktop experience.
Enabled ServoERP's Velopack update channel by default: releases now download silently in the background and install automatically when the user closes ServoERP.
Kept update installation data-safe by applying only fully downloaded packages and backing up local configuration before the updater restarts the app.
Dashboard summary cards now appear before Recent Activity.
Quotation validity now uses a calendar date synchronized with the due date.
Dashboard, Master Data, Clients, and Reports now refresh from centralized service-backed data.

Shared Office Storage can now automatically detect the configured office SQL Server and propose its standard `\\SERVER\ServoERPShared` folder. The connection check runs in the background, with manual UNC entry still available for non-standard shares.

Added an explicit Convert Prospect to Active action in client menus, backed by the existing persisted lifecycle update.

Added Checklist / Tasks scrolling for long invoice workflows.

Removed PDF selection from other sales import pickers so Quotations return to Excel workbook import only.
Added PDF import support to the shared sales import flow, starting with text-based quotation PDFs.
Extended quotation imports to extract readable PDF quotation numbers, dates, client names, subjects, totals, GST, and line items into native ServoERP quotations.
Updated sales import pickers and folder import messaging so Quotations, Invoices, Payments, Purchases, and Jobs can select Excel or PDF files cleanly while unsupported PDFs fail with clear guidance.
Simplified the Quotations dashboard to Recent Quotations and Quotation Value Sent only.
Added company and 1, 2, 3, or 12 month filters.
Added smoke coverage for quotation dashboard company filtering.
Fixed Zydus-style MSE quotation workbooks using Quantity headers.
Expanded imported quotation line descriptions and corrected India-style quotation date parsing.
Changed quotation dashboard default range to all quotation history so imported batches appear immediately.
Added Master Data folder import so ServoERP scans and imports multiple supported Excel workbooks automatically.
Added quotation folder smoke coverage for multiple MSE quotation workbooks.
Fixed MSE quotation imports so the client name is read from the real client block below To instead of the To label.
Added support for HSN/UOM and BOQ supply/installation quotation layouts.
Published MSE printable quotation workbook import support so uploaded quotation files become native ServoERP quotations with item lines and GST totals.
Added shared storage configuration for office-wide ServoERP files using `\\SERVERPC\ServoERPShared`.

Routed backups, company templates, quotation documents, supplier reports, form-template working copies, and dashboard layout files through the shared storage root with local fallback if the network share is unavailable.
Fixed the GitHub desktop release workflow so reruns for an already-published tagged commit exit cleanly instead of failing as a duplicate release.
Kept the release guard strict for new commits that reuse an already-published version, with clearer guidance to bump VERSION before shipping.
Fixed Recent Suppliers status dropdowns so closed rows do not show blue selected-text highlights.
Added a scrollable Recent Suppliers table area with the paging controls fixed below the card.
Enlarged the Master Data Data Control Center hero card for clearer import workflow visibility.
